usage: The word "相機" (soeng2 gei1) is a noun that refers to a device used to take pictures.
"相機" can be used to describe both digital and traditional film cameras.
When using "相機", you can combine it with verbs like "攞" (to take) or "用" (to use) to form common phrases.
"相機" is often used in everyday speech when talking about photography or capturing moments.
You can specify different types of cameras by adding adjectives before "相機", such as "手機相機" (phone camera) or "專業相機" (professional camera).
